statement: The pinned Linux v7.3 f_hid userspace GET_REPORT API exposes only the requested report ID, not the report type and requested transfer length; its fixed response buffer is 64 bytes. Missing/late reports fall back to cached data or zero-filled data rather than a userspace-selected negative control reply. Consequently an upgrade from pre-v6.12 restores a positive response mechanism but does not satisfy the full metadata and explicit negative-response contract required by virtualgamepad.

applicability.revision: Linux mainline v6.11, v6.12 or v7.3 as pinned; family revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: USB HID class-control path in mainline v7.3. No claim that every specific feature probe exceeds the buffer or fails; host and application compatibility not run.
